title: 15 黑蛛刀16 可怕的修士
content_zh:
洛豪长啸一声，此刻甚至想着找一个凝元期的修士来大战一场，洛豪甚至觉得就算再碰到一头结真后期的飞雾蟒兽也不一定就需要依靠真元球才能够战胜。
毒蛛灵兽既然能够与飞雾蟒兽在这里共同生活自然不会惧怕飞雾蟒兽，而洛豪使用毒蛛灵兽的黑脚打造的黑蛛刀说不定也能够砍杀飞雾蟒兽。
之前洛豪之所以砍不动飞雾蟒兽，也与向阳的长刀只是下品攻击灵器有关。
洛豪将黑蛛刀挂在了背上，然后施展神识遁准备离开这里。
当洛豪的神识扫到那头追杀吞草鼠并成功吞吃吞草鼠的飞雾蟒兽嗖嗖的往他这边赶来时，洛豪果然真的停了下来，等待飞雾蟒兽的到来。
之前没有拿到飞雾蟒兽的灵兽内丹，洛豪也有些不甘心，但这次洛豪决定一定要拿到飞雾蟒兽的灵兽内丹。
那说不定也是一颗二级的灵兽内丹。
半柱香后，飞雾蟒兽终于赶到了这里，当它看到洛豪竟然就站在原地等着它，伸出了蛇信子，好像是在惊奇的说你居然不逃走。
不过洛豪显然是不懂的，因为洛豪根本就不等飞雾蟒兽发动攻击，就挥出黑蛛刀。
一道绚烂的刀虹被洛豪轰出，这道刀虹就好像要把整个天空给点亮一般，气势磅礴，远远不是之前的刀虹所能相比的，刀虹所过之处，一道数丈长的坑洞顿时就出现在了地面上。
飞雾蟒兽似乎也察觉到了这道刀虹的不一般，嘶嘶一声，使出一记飞蛇摆尾，那巨大的蛇尾宛如一根巨大的长鞭一般扫向了那道徇烂的刀虹。
轰轰轰，巨大的撞击声响起，洛豪挥出的刀虹在飞雾蟒兽的飞蛇摆尾扫击下，气势竟然慢慢的弱了下来，刀虹在渐渐消失。
十几秒后，刀虹迅速的消失了，而同一时间，飞雾蟒兽也被刀虹给撞击的后退了几百米远，飞雾蟒兽的蛇尾也出现了淡淡的刀痕，那是刀虹的撞击所带来的的。
洛豪显然也没有想到这刀虹这么强大，居然能够在飞雾蟒兽的蛇尾上留下刀痕，要知道飞雾蟒兽的蛇尾的坚硬度比身体强悍几倍不止，之前他全力一击，也勉强只能在飞雾蟒兽的身体上留下刀痕。
而他现在使用黑蛛刀随意的一道刀虹，就能将飞雾蟒兽的比身体还坚硬的蛇尾划出刀痕，这让洛豪十分的惊喜，按照这样的势头打下去，洛豪自信一定能够将这头飞雾蟒兽斩杀。
飞雾蟒兽被激怒了，蛇尾幻化成无数的蛇影，一记无影蛇尾扫向了洛豪，洛豪的眼中根本就看不到蛇尾，只能看到许许多多蛇尾的影子袭来。
洛豪丝毫不敢大意，黑蛛刀轰下，一道数丈长的刀幕化为了一堵气墙挡在了洛豪的眼前，这正是洛豪的招牌技能-浮沉刀。
这次的浮沉刀与以往的浮沉刀有很大的区别，不仅仅是刀幕的坚硬，还有范围以及刀幕的气势，甚至可以将一个结真后期的修士给碾压成为碎片。
但就算是如此强大的浮沉刀，面对飞雾蟒兽的无影蛇尾，竟然撞击出像玻璃碎裂一样的声音，无影蛇尾的攻击瞬间就将浮沉刀所产生的气墙给轰碎。
轰轰轰，猛烈的撞击声传来，洛豪使出黑蛛刀双手一挡，那撞击产生的余波就被洛豪给挡了下来，但这强大的气势却也让洛豪倒退了数百步远，相比洛豪的倒退。

飞雾蟒兽倒退的更多，飞雾蟒兽的蛇尾上的刀痕越来越大，甚至产生了疼痛的感觉，让飞雾蟒兽的行动变得迟缓了一些，同时飞雾蟒兽也硬生生的被击飞了数百米远。
洛豪定睛一看，大喜，飞雾蟒兽的战斗力被他削弱了，洛豪毫不客气的带着黑蛛刀轰然而上，数千道更为凝练的刀气从四面八方形成了一个包围圈，将飞雾蟒兽给笼罩在了其中。
这并没有完，洛豪再次挥着黑蛛刀，轰下一记浮沉刀，又是一道数丈长的刀幕凝结成波浪一般，席卷向飞雾蟒兽。
这漫天的气势，甚至可以将一个凝元初期的修士给打成重伤，就算是没有受伤的飞雾蟒兽全力也不一定能够挡下，何况是已经受伤了的飞雾蟒兽呢？
果然，只见飞雾蟒兽再次使出一记无影蛇尾，想要将浮沉刀和数千道刀气给轰飞，却发现它的蛇尾被刀气给扫中，噗嗤噗嗤的声音不断响起。
那是刀气划过皮肤的声音，飞雾蟒兽的蛇皮都被刀气给划了出来，露出了白花花的血肉，要是再深一点，甚至可以见到飞雾蟒兽的内脏了。
这一下，就让飞雾蟒兽的蛇尾再也挥动不起来，飞雾蟒兽再次被击飞了数百米远。
“杀。“洛豪长啸一声，再次挥出一刀，这一刀是往飞雾蟒兽的蛇头挥去的。
飞雾蟒兽虽然受了重伤，但是它却顽强的张开血盆大口，迎接洛豪的全力一刀。
content_en:
Luo Hao roared loudly, and at this moment he even thought about finding a monk at the Condensation Stage to have a fight. Luo Hao even felt that even if he encountered a Flying Mist Python in the late stage of Condensation, he would not necessarily need to rely on the True Yuan Ball to defeat it.
Since the poisonous spider spirit beast can live together with the flying mist python beast here, it will naturally not be afraid of the flying mist python beast, and the black spider knife made by Luo Hao using the black feet of the poisonous spider spirit beast may also be able to kill the flying mist python beast.
The reason why Luo Hao couldn't cut down the flying mist python before was also related to the fact that Xiang Yang's long sword was only a low-grade attack weapon.
Luo Hao hung the Black Spider Sword on his back, then used Divine Escape to prepare to leave.
When Luo Hao's consciousness scanned the flying mist python that was chasing the grass-eating rat and successfully swallowed it, rushing toward him, Luo Hao really stopped and waited for the flying mist python to arrive.
Luo Hao was a little unwilling to get the Spiritual Beast Inner Elixir of the Flying Mist Python before, but this time Luo Hao decided to get the Spiritual Beast Inner Elixir of the Flying Mist Python.
That might also be a second-level spiritual beast inner elixir.
After half a stick of incense, the flying mist python finally arrived here. When it saw Luo Hao standing there waiting for it, it stretched out its snake letter, as if to say in surprise that you didn't run away.
But Luo Hao obviously didn't understand, because Luo Hao didn't even wait for the flying mist python to attack before he swung the black spider knife.
A gorgeous sword rainbow was blasted out by Luo Hao. This sword rainbow seemed to light up the entire sky. It was so majestic that it was far beyond what the previous sword rainbow could compare to. Wherever the sword rainbow passed, a pit several feet long suddenly appeared on the ground.
The flying mist python seemed to have noticed that this sword rainbow was unusual. With a hiss, it used a flying snake to swing its tail. The huge snake tail swept towards the smashing sword rainbow like a huge whip.
Boom boom boom, a huge impact sounded. The sword rainbow swung by Luo Hao was swept by the flying snake tail of the flying mist python. The momentum slowly weakened, and the sword rainbow gradually disappeared.
After more than ten seconds, the sword rainbow quickly disappeared, and at the same time, the flying mist python was also hit by the sword rainbow and retreated several hundred meters away. There were also faint knife marks on the flying mist python's tail, which were caused by the impact of the sword rainbow.
Luo Hao obviously did not expect that the sword rainbow was so powerful that it could leave knife marks on the tail of the flying mist python. You must know that the tail of the flying mist python is several times stronger than its body. Before, he could barely leave knife marks on the body of the flying mist python with all his strength.
And now he can use the black spider sword to make a slash on the tail of the flying mist python that is harder than its body. This makes Luo Hao very surprised. If he continues with this momentum, Luo Hao is confident that he will be able to kill the flying mist python.
The flying mist python was enraged, and the snake tail transformed into countless snake shadows. A shadowless snake tail swept towards Luo Hao. Luo Hao could not see the snake tail at all in his eyes, and could only see the shadows of many snake tails coming towards him.
Luo Hao did not dare to be careless at all. The black spider knife struck down, and a blade screen several feet long turned into a wall of air blocking Luo Hao's eyes. This was Luo Hao's signature skill - the floating and sinking knife.
This time the floating sword is very different from the previous floating swords, not only the hardness of the sword screen, but also the range and the momentum of the sword screen, which can even crush a late-stage monk into pieces.
But even with such a powerful floating knife, when faced with the Shadowless Snake Tail of the Flying Mist Python, it actually made a sound like breaking glass. The attack of the Shadowless Snake Tail instantly shattered the air wall generated by the Floating and Sinking Knife.
Boom boom boom, a violent impact came. Luo Hao used the Black Spider Sword to block it with both hands. The aftermath of the impact was blocked by Luo Hao, but this powerful momentum also caused Luo Hao to retreat hundreds of steps, compared to Luo Hao's retreat.
The flying mist python retreated even more, and the knife marks on the flying mist python's tail became larger and larger, even causing pain.The feeling of pain made the Flying Mist Python beast's movements become a little slower, and at the same time, the Flying Mist Python beast was also knocked hundreds of meters away.
Luo Hao took a closer look and was overjoyed. The fighting power of the Flying Mist Python was weakened by him. Luo Hao rushed forward unceremoniously with the black spider knife. Thousands of more condensed sword energy formed an encirclement from all directions and enveloped the Flying Mist Python.
This was not over yet. Luo Hao once again wielded the black spider sword and struck a floating sword. Another sword curtain several feet long condensed into a wave and swept towards the flying mist python.
This aura that fills the sky can even seriously injure a monk in the early stage of Yuan Condensation. Even an uninjured Flying Mist Python Beast may not be able to stop it with its full strength, let alone an already injured Flying Mist Python Beast?
Sure enough, the Flying Mist Python Beast once again used its shadowless snake tail, trying to blow away the floating sword and thousands of sword energy. However, it found that its snake tail was swept away by the sword energy, and the sound of puffs and puffs continued to sound.
That was the sound of the sword energy cutting across the skin. The flying mist python beast's snake skin was scratched out by the sword energy, exposing the white flesh and blood. If it were deeper, you could even see the flying mist python beast's internal organs.
At this moment, the flying mist python could no longer swing its tail, and the flying mist python was once again knocked hundreds of meters away.
"Kill." Luo Hao roared and swung his knife again. This time he swung the knife towards the snake head of the flying mist python.
Although the Flying Mist Python was seriously injured, it still opened its bloody mouth tenaciously to receive Luo Hao's full blow.
